name: plugin-review-provider-lanes
title: PARKED: Add gemini and kimi as opt-in parallel local review providers when installed as plugins
description: Once codex is a configured local review provider, add gemini and kimi as sibling providers that run in the existing parallel pool, gated on both plugin installation and an explicit operator opt-in, so a machine without them -- or an operator who never opted in -- behaves exactly as it does today. Installation is a capability signal, not consent.
creator: sdelmas
